bills.title: EU Artificial Intelligence Act
bills.sponsorsNote: Adopted by the European Parliament and the Council.
bills.statusNote: In force since Aug. 1, 2024; obligations apply in phases.
bills.summary: Risk-based rules for AI across the EU: bans on certain uses, duties for high-risk systems and for general-purpose AI models, applied in phases. Member states such as France implement and enforce it rather than deciding whether to regulate.

bills.title: Digital Omnibus on AI
bills.sponsorsNote: Adopted by the European Parliament and the Council.
bills.statusNote: Final Council approval June 29, 2026; in force July 27, 2026.
bills.summary: Delays high-risk AI Act duties (stand-alone systems to Dec. 2, 2027; AI in regulated products to Aug. 2, 2028), bans AI systems generating non-consensual intimate images and child sexual abuse material, and simplifies documentation for smaller firms. Transparency duties and general-purpose AI rules keep their original dates.
